articles.title: Bitcoin takes a breather after adding 23% in 7 days as ETF demand holds steady
articles.snippet: The price of bitcoin fell to $79,000 on Wednesday after gaining 23% in seven days as August ETF inflows climbed above $3 billion.

articles.title: A massive $6.4 billion bitcoin options expiry on Friday could amplify volatility
articles.snippet: Friday’s expiry follows bitcoin’s surge from $62,000 to $80,000, leaving market makers with increased exposure to manage around several key strike prices.

articles.title: Tokenized deposits could raise US credit costs: Dallas Fed economists
articles.snippet: Dallas Fed economists said faster, programmable deposits could make bank funding less stable, potentially pushing lenders toward more expensive funding.

articles.title: 77% of Americans see crypto in retirement plans as risky: Survey
articles.snippet: A new survey finds broad skepticism toward crypto in workplace retirement plans as US policymakers move to expand access to alternative assets.

articles.title: Nvidia Shares Surge in After-Hours Trading After Record $96.2 Billion Revenue
articles.snippet: The chipmaker doubled quarterly revenue while disclosing $366 billion in future commitments and up to $108.5 billion in guarantee exposure.
